heading: arg(P), signed principal difference in (-pi,pi]
physical_displacement: mean endpoint circumference × principal heading difference / (2pi)
histogram: 600 symmetric asinh-spaced physical displacement bins from -2 nominal C to +2 nominal C (covers instantaneous Spring circumference), asinh scale C*1e-4; transform x by 1/sqrt(lag), density by sqrt(lag)
selection: all retained complete seeds; no seed selection
nonfinite: only nonfinite numeric differences excluded; count retained per condition
